task: Find founder-owned US commercial HVAC service companies in Texas with 50-300 employees and no institutional investors

ownership_changes.why: Multi-generational family-held Subchapter S corporation with a Letsos family partnership. Family ownership satisfies the criterion, and no PE, institutional investor, corporate parent or public listing appears.
BuildZoom lists an individual owner, Ben Heilker, which indicates owner-operated. No institutional investor appears. Confidence is low.
Directory profiles describe the company as family-owned, and no institutional investor appears. The size concern is outside this ownership criterion.
The company states it is family-owned, and no institutional investor appears. Its residential focus is outside this ownership criterion.
Self-described as privately owned, with Tommy Barnes listed as President/Owner, which indicates owner-operated. No investor news was found.
